item.title: 0.14.2-beta.1
item.description:
Aki 0.14.2-beta.1

Fixed

  • Type in the app below while marking: ⇧-click into an address bar or a search box and what you type goes there (the keys stayed with Aki). Click on the marking again to go back to it.

Aki 0.14.1

Fixed

  • Lighter on your Mac: Aki now uses about a quarter of the processor it did while idle. Token use is counted again only from the logs macOS says changed, session files are reread only when they change, and the sidebar rests while the screen sleeps or is locked.
  • ⇧⌘A outlines right away what is under the pointer: it used to wait for the mouse to move.
  • An area's picture is just that area: it used to take in a bit around it, often the lines above and below.

item.title: 0.14.1-beta.6
item.description:
Aki 0.14.1-beta.6

Fixed

  • Aki uses much less of the Mac while idle: it no longer adds up your token use again when nothing changed, rereads only the session files that changed, and rests while the screen sleeps or is locked.
  • The picture of an area you draw is just that area: it took in a bit around it, often the lines above and below.
  • ⇧⌘A outlines what is under the pointer right away: it waited for the mouse to move.

Aki 0.14.0

New

  • + New on the marking card: no terminal open yet? Open Claude or Codex in a new Orca tab, or a new conversation in the Claude or Codex app, in the project you pick, with your marks as its first message.
  • Pick several marks in History: tick the box at the start of each row (shift-click ticks every mark in between), then send them all to one session, mark them done or delete them together.

Aki 0.13.0

New

  • Limit resets in the Claude and Codex cards: use one of Codex's right from Aki (it asks first), or go straight to Claude's usage page to use one there.

Fixes

  • With more than one display, only the screen you're on holds still while a hover menu is kept, as with the Mac's ⌘⇧4: the others keep running.
  • A localhost page served from a Claude session's own scratchpad folder goes to that session, whatever its tab is called.
  • Claude's usage ring follows the session that talked to Claude last: after you reset your limit it kept showing the old share.
  • The list of more terminals fits its card: with many sessions its top was cut off.
